taskPreset.title: Run a CodeGraph task
taskPreset.description: Manage CodeGraph indexes and explore architecture in selected or all available MonoSpecs child repositories.

commands.groupDescription: Choose one graph lifecycle or architecture operation.
commands.initDescription: Initialize and build a project graph.

commands.syncDescription: Synchronize a project graph on demand.
commands.upgradeDescription: Upgrade the installed CodeGraph CLI once.
commands.uninitDescription: Remove a project's graph index without uninstalling the CLI.
commands.exploreDescription: Use codegraph_explore to answer an architecture or impact question.
